MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Morphology and Anatomy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
